post.summary: Get an eSIM profile information for a given MSISDN and profileType

200.description: Information about new allocated eSIM Profile in case of success.

iccid.description: ICCID as described in ITU-T E.118

profileType.description: Content free information defined by the Operator (e.g.‘P9054-2’)

timestamp.description: Date and time when the operation has been performed, in string format as specified by W3C: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssTZD (E.g. 2001-12-17T09:30:47Z)

matchingId.description: OPTIONAL - The matchingId from the procedure request

smdpAddress.description: OPTIONAL - The SM-DP address of the affected DP+

lastModified.description: OPTIONAL - Date and time when the profile was last updated. Not affected by profile registration

notificationPointId.description: Identification of the step reached in the procedure

resultData.description: base64 encoded binary data containing the Result data contained in the ProfileInstallationResult

functionCallIdentifier.description: identification of the function call: HandleDownloadProgressInfo

iccid.description: Integrated Circuit Card Identifier Il s'agit d'un identifiant de 19 (20 digits avec bourrage) qui identifie de manière unique un profile eSIM au niveau mondial. Il est retourné suite à la demande de réservation du profil eSIM.

activationCode.description: Ce code est retourné par enabler eSIM si l'appel est effectué en définissant le profileStatus à "downloadable" ou "downloadableWithConfirmationCode" Le code d'activation retourné permet de générer le QR Code nécessaire au téléchargement du profil eSIM.

confirmationCode.description: Ce code est retourné en complément de l'activationCode si l'appel est effectué en définissant le profileStatus à "downloadableWithConfirmationCode". Le code de confirmation permet de sécuriser le téléchargement du profil (dépend des canaux). Il est généré par le module eSIM qui le transmet à  SM-DP+ dans le cas où le profileStatus est définit avec "downloadableWithConfirmationCode".

code.description: Functional error code defined by the Service.

name.description: Reference of the system at the origin of the error.

httpCode.description: HTTP status code returned by source system.

SourceData.description: Nested object describing the source system and error which cause a failure.

SourceError.description: Object describing the source cause of a functional error or failure during an operation.

profileType.description: Profile type requested for the new eSIM profile to allocate.

msisdn.description: obligatoire pour intérroger la base de livraisons

EsimProfileRequest.description: Recuperer un profil disponible pour un MSISDN

iccid.description: The ICCID (Integrated Circuit Card IDentifier, i.e. eSIM profile identifier) identifying the new eSIM profile allocated. The ICCID is a numeric value of 20 digits.

imsi.description: The Subscriber identifier associated to the new eSIM profile allocated. The IMSI is a numeric value of 15 digits.

AllocateProfileResponse.description: Data returned as response to eSIM Profile allocate request.

profileType.description: Profile type requested for the new eSIM profile to allocate.

cid.description: The identifier of customer contract. Generally MSISDN(590690000000).

eid.description: The EID identifying the eUICC (embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card) to link to the eSIM Profile. The EID must be a numeric value of 32 digits and respect the following control: (Value(EID) modulo 97) = 1

AllocateProfileRequest.description: Data required to allocate a new eSIM Profile

CancelProfileRequest.description: Data required to cancel a non downloaded eSIM Profile.

iccid.description: The ICCID (Integrated Circuit Card IDentifier, i.e. eSIM profile identifier) identifying the new eSIM profile allocated. The ICCID is a numeric value of 20 digits.

imsi.description: The Subscriber identifier associated to the new eSIM profile allocated. The IMSI is a numeric value of 15 digits.

eid.description: The EID identifying the eUICC (embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card) linked to the eSIM Profile. The EID must be a numeric value of 32 digits. It is always present in this response when the deliveryMode is set to "defaultSMDPplus".

activationCode.description: A code built using the SM-DP+ address, the MatchingID and the confirmationCode if any is specified as parameter. It is always present in this response when the deliveryMode is set to "AC".

matchingId.description: Reference of the eSIM profile to be downloaded. It is always present in this response when the deliveryMode is set to "AC".

confirmationCode.description: A code used to authorise the usage of the MatchingID to confirm the download and installation of the eSIM Profile. It can be present (optional) in this response when the deliveryMode is set to "AC".

DeliverProfileResponse.description: Data returned as response to eSIM Profile delivery request.

deliveryMode.description: Required delivery mode to deliver the specified eSIM Profile. Possible values are : "defaultSMDPplus", "AC", "SMDS". This value determines which others fields are required or not according to the following rules:  * __defaultSMDPplus__:     - eid is required if it was not sent in the previous allocation call    - smdsAddress should not be set  * __AC__: (Activation Code)    - if the matchingId is not present, SM-DP+ will generates a new matchingId for _ActivationCodeToken_    - smdsAddress should not be set  * __SMDS__:    - eid is required if it was not sent in the previous allocation call    - if the matchingId is present, it will be used as EventID    - smdsAddress is required

eid.description: The EID identifying the eUICC (embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card) to link to the eSIM Profile. The EID must be a numeric value of 32 digits and respect the following control: (Value(EID) modulo 97) = 1. _See the description of field deliveryMode for the usage rules._

matchingId.description: Reference of the eSIM profile to be downloaded. _See the description of field deliveryMode for the usage rules._

confirmationCode.description: A code used to authorise the usage of the MatchingID to confirm the download and installation of the eSIM Profile. _See the description of field deliveryMode for the usage rules._

smdsAddress.description: The SM-DS address to be used for Event Registration with the SM-DP+ server. _See the description of field deliveryMode for the usage rules._

DeliverProfileRequest.description: Data required to deliver a previously allocated eSIM Profile.

iccid.description: The ICCID (Integrated Circuit Card IDentifier, i.e. eSIM profile identifier) identifying the new eSIM profile allocated. The ICCID is a numeric value of 20 digits.

imsi.description: The Subscriber identifier associated to the new eSIM profile allocated. The IMSI is a numeric value of 15 digits.

profileType.description: The requested profile type identifier for this eSIM profile.

profileStatus.description: The state of the profile resulting from a successful operation. The values to consider are ALLOCATED, LINKED, RELEASED, DOWNLOADED, INSTALLED, ENABLED, DISABLED, DELETED, ERROR. Other values are possible due to SMDP+ vendors proprietary implementation, but they should not to be considered as exploitable values.

lastOperationDone.description: The last operation attempted on the profile.

lastOperationResult.description: The result of the last operation attempted on the profile. If lastOperationResult is 'failed', then lastOperationErrorDetails is present.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode of the eSIM profile.

eid.description: The EID identifying the eUICC (embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card) linked to the eSIM profile. The EID must be a numeric value of 32 digits.

activationCode.description: The activation code for the profile. Present only if deliveryMode=AC and profileStatus=RELEASED.

matchingId.description: The matching ID of the profile. Present only if deliveryMode=AC and profileStatus=RELEASED.

confirmationCode.description: The activation code for the profile. Present only if exists and deliveryMode=AC and profileStatus=RELEASED.

smdsAddress.description: The matching ID of the profile. Present only if deliveryMode=SMDS and profileStatus=RELEASED.

GetProfileResponse.description: Profile data for the GET profile API.

version.description: The version of the API. exp 2.0

GetStatusResponse.description: Data returned as response to GET Profile Status request.

code.description: Functional error code defined by the Service.
